# GeFlow

> GeFlow is a modern, fast, and humanized retail POS and inventory management platform. Built for pharmacies, supermarkets, grocery stores, fashion boutiques, and warehouses.

## Overview
GeFlow helps retail shop owners, store managers, cashiers, and warehouse operators track inventory, process rapid checkout sales, issue clean thermal receipts (80mm & 58mm), manage supplier purchases, record customer credits (Udhar / Khata), and audit profits in real time.

## Core Capabilities
- Point of Sale Terminal (POS): Instant barcode lookup, customizable payment methods (Cash, Card, Digital Wallets, Udhar Store Credit), tax calculation toggles, discount controls, and automatic inventory subtraction.
- Thermal Receipt Printing: High-speed, printer-compatible receipts supporting Poppins, monospace, and receipt-optimized thermal fonts with customizable store header, contact information, and footer greetings.
- Inventory & Stock Management: Complete catalog with product variants, SKU tracking, category filtering, unit of measures (UoM), low-stock warning triggers, and out-of-stock management.
- Customer Khata & Store Credit (Udhar): Full customer credit ledger with balance tracking, credit limit warnings, instant payment collection, and history statements.
- Purchases & Supplier Restocking: Purchase orders, invoice recording, cost price tracking, and automatic inventory restocking.
- Returns & Replacements: Customer returns processing with automatic inventory restock and financial adjustment.
- Financial Reports & Analytics: Net profit calculation, cost-of-goods-sold (COGS), gross margin analysis, sales velocity, and tax ledgers.
- Team Access Control (RBAC): Multi-user permissions for store owners, managers, cashiers, and stock clerks with isolated workspace access.
